summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The SEI Enhanced U.S. Large Cap Quality Factor ETF (SEIQ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund actively selects US large-cap stocks it perceives as high quality, based on various quality, profitability, and risk factors. SEIQ was launched on May 18, 2022 and is issued by SEI.

holdings.infoBox: SEIQ is an equity ETF with a total of 64 individual holdings. The top holdings are Apple stock at 8.01%, Microsoft at 7.64%, NVIDIA at 7.52%, Johnson & Johnson at 3.88%, and Cisco Systems at 3.14%.
